{{Short description|Dutch-Israeli chemist (1927–2019)}}
'''Joost Manassen''' ({{langx|he|יוסט מנסן}}; 17 February 1927 – October 2019) was a Dutch-Israeli chemist who was a professor at the faculty of chemistry of the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]].

==Career==
Manassen was born on 17 February 1927 in [[Amersfoort]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://archiefeemland.courant.nu/issue/ADDE/1927-02-17/edition/0/page/3 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200601165707/https://archiefeemland.courant.nu/issue/ADDE/1927-02-17/edition/0/page/3 |title=De Heer en Mevrouw J. Manassen geven kennis van de geboorte van hun zoon Joost. |language=nl |page=3 |publisher=Amersfoortsch Dagblad "De Eemlander" |date=17 February 1927 |archive-date=1 June 2020}}</ref> During [[World War II]] he went into hiding from the [[Nazi Germany|Nazis]] on a farm in [[North Holland]].<ref name=wei>{{cite web|url=https://www.weizmann.ac.il/materials/joost-menassen |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200601174412/https://www.weizmann.ac.il/materials/joost-menassen |title=Joost Menassen |language=he |publisher=Weizmann Institute of Science |date=6 January 2020 |archive-date=1 June 2020}}</ref> In 1959 he obtained his PhD at the [[University of Amsterdam]] under Professor F.L.J. Sixma with a thesis titled, "Reactions of the n-butenes and 2-butanol in dilute acid solution : a mechanistic study".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://albumacademicum.uva.nl/id/id043332 |title=J. Manassen, 1927 - |language=nl |publisher=University of Amsterdam}}</ref> Manassen moved to Israel and started working for the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]]. In the 1970s, after the [[1973 oil crisis]], Manassen worked on alternative energy based on [[solar power]]. In 1983 he became head of the Department of Materials Research.<ref name=wei/> Manassen died in [[Rehovot]] in October 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.weizmann.ac.il/chemistry/memoriam |title=About us - In memoriam |publisher=Weizmann Institute of Science - Faculty of Chemistry |date=1 June 2020 |access-date=1 June 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://data.bnf.fr/fr/16689690/joost_manassen/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200601170801/https://data.bnf.fr/fr/16689690/joost_manassen/ |title=Joost Manassen (1927-2019) |language=fr |publisher=Bibliothèque nationale de France |archive-date=1 June 2020}}</ref>

Manassen was elected a corresponding member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1986.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/correspondents/4510 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200425141844/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/correspondents/4510 |title=Joost Manassen |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |archive-date=25 April 2020}}</ref>
